lines.en: I crawl low across the ground.
My head is bigger than my body.
All my teeth show on the outside.
I drag my body toward you.
Every step looks like chewing.
Red prints glisten on the mud.
I only know forward.
My jaw stays open.
I pull myself along on my forelimbs.
I slip through the grass.

lines.zh: 我一节一节地拖着自己。
lines.en: I haul myself along, segment by segment.
My mouth hangs open the whole way.
Smelling the blood in you.
I'm not thinking about anything.
My teeth click against each other.
My belly growls against the ground.
My body twitches.
Old blood stains this ground.
My mouth will never close.
I'm always painfully hungry.
I'm always very hungry.
I lift my body again.
Your blood is pulsing.
I know the mud smell on your feet.
Let me have one bite of you.
Just one bite. Only one.
You're all warmth.
My teeth are already bared.
Don't back off. Don't.

lines.zh: 我的嘴一直张着，合不上。
lines.en: My mouth hangs open and won't close.
You're closer than I thought.
I only need a little.
I curl up, then lunge out again.
My teeth got knocked loose.
I flattened back to the ground.
Crimson leaked out.
I'm still crawling forward.

lines.zh: 我的头比身子大，撞得我偏了。
lines.en: My head is bigger than my body, and it knocked me aside.
My mouth has never closed.
I don't care about any of it.
I sank my teeth into the ground.
I'm still hungry right now.
That thing isn't blood.
I don't want this.
I want something hot.
Take it away. I can't bite it.
It doesn't pulse.
I'm only interested in the living.
This doesn't move when I bite.
You're holding something better.
I never eat anything dry.
Don't hold that out. Give me your hand.
You hit my teeth.
I'm crawling up against you.
Don't push. I'm trying to bite.
I'm wet all over.
Your leg is beside my mouth.
I pushed up and fell back.
Step on me again, see what happens.
I pulled back and pressed in again.
Crimson is on your foot now.
Let me lean on you a moment.
All I do is bite.

lines.zh: 这具身体什么都不需要。
lines.en: This body needs nothing.

lines.zh: 我连自己的样子都不记得。
lines.en: I don't remember my own shape.
Biting is all that's in my head.
Apart from hunger, I think of nothing.
Don't talk by my mouth.
I turn my head and keep sniffing.
This doesn't matter at all.
I discuss nothing.
I just want to bite things.
I bit it once.
My teeth won't go into this.
It doesn't smell of blood.
I drag it into my mouth.
I spat it right out.
My forelimbs can't hold it.
It fell by my mouth.
There's no blood smell to this.
I cover it with my belly.
It's really too small.
Something's moving. I smell it.
I've fixed on your blood.
My head keeps turning toward you.
I fix on the tendon at your ankle.
Your foot is right before my mouth.

lines.zh: 我一寸一寸靠近，不急着咬。
lines.en: I inch closer, in no hurry to bite.
My teeth are on the outside.

lines.zh: 你先动的那一下我记住了。
lines.en: I remember when you moved first.
I've opened my mouth.
I haul my body toward you.
Your heel is very near me.

lines.zh: 这片地面上的血都在叫我。
lines.en: The blood on this ground calls to me.
I just go forward like this.
One step back and you're on me.
I'm getting more frantic.
I can reach from here.
The smell of you is moving.
I follow, pressed to the ground.
Your legs are still moving.
I can hear your blood.

lines.zh: 我不需要站起来，也够得着。
lines.en: I do not need to stand to reach you.
Go on. Step back again.
My teeth keep opening and closing.
I'm biting the grass.
I keep pulling myself up.
Standing still suits me best.
I lunge, and then I bite.
I'm half a foot from your foot.
You hit me and I didn't stop.
I'm getting closer and closer.
I smell sweat.
Your blood is beating faster.
The Hungry's mouth never closes.
You can't block a mouth.

lines.zh: 我拖着自己一点点靠近。
lines.en: I drag myself closer, bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面爬，草伏下去。
lines.en: I crawl low and the grass bends down.
My teeth haven't stopped once.
I have no mouth, yet I still bite.

lines.zh: 我这张嘴，只有饿的时候张开。
lines.en: My mouth only opens when starving.
This bite tears open quickly.
My teeth sink into your boot shaft.
My teeth caught on you.
My body wraps your ankle.
My teeth hit the ground and crack.
I pulled myself an inch closer.
You kicked me away with one foot.
My teeth are still clicking.
Crimson smeared all over you.
I've got your hem in my teeth.
My whole head slams down.
I've got your boot in my teeth.
I bit twice on that one.
I bite upward from below.
I raise my head from the ground.
My teeth show first.
Crimson seeps from my seams.
I crawl toward the warmth.
This body is mostly mouth now.
I push up, then flatten again.
There's a wet trail on the ground.
I've started grinding my teeth.
I climb over the dirt mound and crawl toward you.
I haven't found a direction yet.
It's strangely quiet around me.

lines.zh: 土里伸出我的手，先抓草。
lines.en: My hands reach out of the soil and grab the grass.
The hungry lunges with only biting in mind.
I need to find some blood.
Fire dried the crimson on me.

lines.zh: 我摔进了自己挖的土坑。
lines.en: I fell into a pit I'd dug.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的嘴里，我还在咬。
lines.en: Water filled my mouth. I kept biting.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻在地，牙还咬着。
lines.en: The blast flipped me over; my teeth still bite.

lines.zh: 箭扎在我肩上，我照样爬。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shoulder; I keep crawling.
That light curled me up.
Hunger has left me unable to move.
Lightning made my jaw jerk.
I fall, still biting.
